xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope: Now+Later graduation dual-path locks Wave A

plan.title: bug(strategies,scope): Now+Later graduation dual-path locks for intentional under-builds

narratives.Description: Directive lacks a first-class Graduation type for decided weaker Now plus decided end-product Later, so agents collapse intentional under-builds into DeferredDecisions and complete MVP as permanent product. Wave A adds glossary, discuss/probe contract, scope:complete docs, Fail Loud claim language, and soft warn guidance.
narratives.Overview: Wave A docs and strategy contract only; hard gates are Wave B follow-on.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator shipping an intentional under-build, I want dual-path Now+Later locks with graduationRef and trigger, so that completing the Now story does not silently retire the end-product path.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Edit content/strategies/discuss.md and content/strategies/probe.md files to define Graduation dual-path lock fields (now, later, graduationRef, trigger, status) when a lock chooses a temporary approach. Step 2: Edit content/coding/coding.md Fail Loud module for production-ready claims naming open graduationRefs. Step 3: Note in discuss that glossary xbrief naming is owned by #2907 sibling; keep graduation term defined in strategy prose. Step 4: Content-contract unit tests and CHANGELOG cite #2899. Verification: run content-contract tests and task check:merge.
narratives.Labels: bug, enhancement, design, agent-experience, source-of-truth, area:skills

items.title: Glossary defines Graduation vs other laters

narrative.Acceptance: Given glossary, when read, then Graduation is distinct from DeferredDecisions, triage defer, and rapid graduate.

items.title: Discuss/probe require dual-path lock fields when under-building

narrative.Acceptance: Given discuss/probe contracts, when a lock chooses temporary approach, then Now Later graduationRef trigger and status are required.

items.title: scope:complete and Fail Loud honor open graduations

narrative.Acceptance: Given docs, when Now story completes or production-ready is claimed, then open graduation work stays open and claims must name graduationRefs or explicit skip.
Given the PR, when tests run, then narrative/schema requirements are checked and CHANGELOG cites #2899.
